title: RosettaLog OCSF-aligned subset
description: This is an OCSF-aligned subset, not a full OCSF implementation.

retention_rules.unmapped: Vendor-specific attributes remain in unmapped rather than being dropped.
retention_rules.masking: Only the normalized copy may be masked. Raw bytes are preserved in the raw store.
retention_rules.confidence: Each field mapping carries an explicit confidence score.
